decisive_items: Chromogranin A: slight enterochromaffin-like cell hyperplasia
response.rationale: Autoimmune gastritis is favored by immune-mediated corpus changes (lymphocytic infiltration, parietal-cell H+/K+-ATPase reduction, ECL hyperplasia) in a patient with multiple autoimmune diseases; negative anti-parietal cell antibody and normal gastrin do not exclude early/seronegative autoimmune gastritis. Atrophic gastritis is less supported because no established glandular atrophy is described and the cited foveolar hyperplasia is nonspecific.

rejected.why: Only foveolar hyperplasia is cited; endoscopic and histologic findings do not demonstrate glandular atrophy, and H. pylori is negative.
